author: Diana Roach
text: I called the Septic Guys this morning and by 4pm they had completed all the work and did a fabulous job! Great communication and friendly demeanor. Highly recommend.

author: Mark O'Brien
text: Outstanding service! Reasonable rates. They have saved the day for us a couple times by coming out last minute. Once on Christmas Eve. Also offering helpful advice. I highly recommend these folks. I won't bother with anyone else.

author: Christopher Allard
text: The guys did a great job, from communication over the phone to day of service. Came out and made sure the job was done and didn’t cut corners

author: David Chirolo
text:
There team was able to arrive within 1 hour of our initial contact. Job was done professionally and with excellent communication. Serving the Foothill communities for many years. Will certainly use there services in the future.
Thank you.

author: Connie Sanford
text:
We had a septic tank emergency this weekend and The Septic Guys were here FAST. When we bought a house in the country no one told us that a septic tank takes maintenance. They got things running smoothly again and we got practical advice on how to care for our tank.
Great price.
Fast and Friendly Service.
Thanks Guys!
